styles.name: Neo-Memphis
styles.summary: Readable neo-brutalism (paper text blocks, ink borders, hard shadows) with restrained Memphis accents: margin shapes, keycap wordmark, browser-window title cards.

styles.name: Neo-brutalism
styles.summary: Paper ground, thick ink borders, hard offset shadows, flat loud colour blocks, slam-in type.

styles.name: Memphis pop (retro neo-brutalism)
styles.summary: Grid paper, Memphis shapes (squiggles, zigzags, confetti, checkers, sparkles), keycap tiles with extruded shadows, browser-window title cards, outlined extruded headlines, pink/teal/yellow/purple/blue.

styles.name: Modern tech documentary
styles.summary: Dark slate, precise grid, mono data labels, mask reveals, restrained accent colour.

styles.name: Minimalist editorial
styles.summary: Warm off-white, serif headlines, hairline rules, slow fades, magazine-style deks.

styles.name: Fast-paced social
styles.summary: High-contrast black, neon accents, 2-word punch captions, zoom punches, emoji bursts.

styles.name: Cinematic documentary
styles.summary: Letterboxed, film grain, condensed titles, amber accents, long dissolves.
